turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: So tell me how the project actually started.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: It started in my garage with a broken drone and a lot of free time.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: And when did you realize it could become a real business?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Honestly, when strangers started emailing me to ask if they could buy one.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: What was the hardest part of that first year?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Learning to say no to good ideas so we could finish the great ones.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: That sounds like advice everyone needs to hear.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: It is the only advice I really trust.
